summary: 多币种/汇率实现首片 on BASE fcb7b17 (Lead ruling B: contracts-only; cross-owner settlement/revenue/cash/invoicing and verify_integrity remain out of scope). Adds a real managed FxRateSnapshot ORM model in pmo_plugins/contracts/models.py with contracts migration 0007 (CreateModel + vendor-aware SQLite/PG UPDATE/DELETE append-only guards; no core migration, makemigrations clean), and contracts/fx_services.py: record_fx_rate (owner/finance, company lock, exact business date, version increment, dry_run zero-write, plugin-prefixed audit, no historical rewrite), resolve_fx_rate with exact-date lookup and NO nearest-date fallback, resolve_fx_ref, one-time ROUND_HALF_UP convert_cents/convert_original_amounts with book gross=net+tax and 10^12 bounds, fx_rate_list, and contract_line_fx_snapshots (original/book/rate/missing; non-CNY lines require a frozen fx_rate_ref or are reported fx_rate_missing without date fallback). The contract write path is integrated: approval_services._normalize_lines accepts currency/original_net_cents/original_tax_cents/original_gross_cents/fx_rate_ref, rejects CNY rows carrying original/FX data, requires member+effective date context for non-CNY, resolves/validates the frozen rate, verifies client book amounts equal the one-time conversion, and review_version persists currency/original/fx_rate_ref on created ContractLine rows; change_services._derive_deltas and _apply_approved_change use the same normalization and persist the same fields for effective change versions. Non-CNY writes without an exact frozen rate are rejected before any version/line write; historical rows and amounts are never recomputed. UI: fx-rates history_read page + fx-rate-save business_write; owner/finance write, auditor read, PM project-line scope, member denied, disabled-module history read. Tests test_v1_fx.py (8) + _http.py (3): record/list/version/exact-date/no-fallback, permissions/disabled module, one-time conversion, DB/model append-only guards, CNY/non-CNY/missing contract-line display, write-preparation helper, non-CNY contract approval writes currency/original/fx fields, change-version write, invalid no-rate rejection. Deviations: version configuration UI does not yet surface currency/original fields (services/API contract supports them; future UI wiring); cross-owner integration and verify_integrity FX branch remain out of this B slice; payment/warranty term original-currency persistence is not included (line-level only).
